description: React component for displaying a post's profile picture in Mattermost, handling different statuses, icons, and system message conditions.

classes.name: PostProfilePicture
classes.description: React component class for rendering a user's profile picture with status and icon overrides.

methods.name: getProfilePictureURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the user's profile picture based on user and post data.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Determines the user's status string, considering auto-responder, webhook, and bot status.

methods.name: getPostIconURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the post icon, considering override settings and whether to use a default.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the profile picture component, handling system messages, webhooks, bots, and status display.
